Team — quick standing note for this week

We have the Friday submission window coming up (close of business PT). Two asks before our 30m call on Wednesday:

1) Commit numbers: update SFDC with your final commit amount and stage (Prospect/Negotiation/Commit). If you plan to move a deal to "Commit" please add a 1-line justification in the deal notes (what changed, risks remaining).

2) Evidence pack: upload required artifacts to the Drive folder linked below. For governed accounts (Acme included) we need: latest SOW, procurement contact, and any current legal redlines.

Call: Wednesday 10/27, 10:30am PT — short agenda below. Please come with account state and a 2-bullet ask.

Agenda (30m):
- 10:30–10:35: Quick alignment on submission cadence and timing
- 10:35–10:45: Top 3 at-risk commit deals (each rep 2–3 min)
- 10:45–10:55: Evidence gaps and action owners
- 10:55–11:00: Final thanks + next steps

Attachments: ACM-459_MutualActionPlan.docx (draft), evidence-account-ops.xlsx (checklist)
Drive: https://drive.google.com/drive/folders/0A1AcmeExample
HubSpot: 12345

Deadline: update SFDC + Drive by Friday 10/29 EOD PT.

Thanks — keep it tight.

—Kimberly
